A single person referred to by role or kinship: Mom, Dadi, My sister, my cousin, The doctor, Sir. Plural groups (my friends, relatives) are not tagged.
Named places only: Pune, Nagpur, US. Generic places (library, canteen, home, college) are not tagged.

Explicit time references: today, tonight, last night, this morning, Friday, March, next week. Bare words like morning or evening, and durations like two hours, are not tagged.
